name: intl-msg
summary: Resolve a localized message key and interpolate values.

npm.registration: The npm root registers its custom elements automatically.

classic.registration: The script registers its custom elements automatically.

guidance: Use key, not the legacy id alias. Dotted keys resolve nested message objects. Keep fallback text meaningful.
Supply only trusted translation content and trusted interpolations; this component renders output as a template. For untrusted strings, use native textContent.
